text: The slot holds the head `sentences` for `tinyclip-39m-16` (species_com), fitted on `none (sentence rows only)`, with 5911 species rows. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025.wasm-int8-per-channel`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 100, w_kind 0.5, alpha_prior 0.75. On 1803 tuning photos (val) the thresholds came out as name_at 0.27 and offer_at never (no level reached nine in ten). On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 81.4% (80.2 to 82.6); the top species is right for 35.3% (33.9 to 36.8) and is among the first five for 55.1% (53.6 to 56.6). `person` was said for 0.07% of these photos and `none` for 0.07%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind phrases`. With kind_at 0.76 (set on wildlife tuning photos and the extra set's tuning third), the page asserts a kind for 48.8% (47.3 to 50.4) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 97.7% (97.0 to 98.3) of those; for the 51.2% (49.6 to 52.7) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 93.4% (92.4 to 94.5). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds.wasm-int8-per-channel`), the kind is right for 80.1% (77.8 to 82.3); the page asserts a kind for 28.9% (26.4 to 31.4) and is right for 97.8% (96.1 to 99.2) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for 82.9% (80.2 to 85.4). A species is named on 1.2% (0.7 to 1.8) of these photos. The slot needs: fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).
